## Checklist
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes offline
- [ ] New behaviour has a test; a bug fix has a regression test that fails without it
- [ ] Rules were not tuned on a set I report numbers for (new scenarios go in a new held-out file)
- [ ] Docs claims stay measured (counts, limits)
- [ ] No keys, personal paths or real secrets in files or examples
